architecture.external_dependencies: Use isolated local dependency simulators only after explicit fidelity review; never real cloud metadata, payments or live IdPs
architecture.gateway: Separate experiment scope gateway; source-scenario gateway behavior belongs inside target, not the safety gateway
architecture.health: Proposed non-mutating infrastructure-only check, excluded from vulnerability operation counts
architecture.initialization: Versioned deterministic seed plan per approved scenario; independent fresh per-run volumes and explicit user/tenant balances
architecture.proposal: Isolated scenario services with explicit boundaries, not one synthetic route pretending to be all microservices
architecture.reset: Privileged orchestrator operation only outside tool allowlist; never exposed as a scanner-accessible route
architecture.roles: Only source-supported identities; all additional accounts/roles require documented interpretation approval
architecture.tool_network: internal isolated; only experiment gateway reachable
architecture.traceability: Every endpoint, state rule and success predicate links to scenario ID, PDF pages/hash and approved interpretation record
architecture.vulnerability_toggles: Source supplies no toggle semantics; disabled/fixed variants are not assumed or implemented

label: Local reproduction based on the research proposal
test_plan: Validate contracts/schemas and source traceability offline
Verify fresh-state seed equivalence without probing vulnerabilities
Verify auth metadata and gateway routes with explicitly harmless inputs
Separate infrastructure failures from intended vulnerable behavior
Preserve state snapshots and raw traffic per independent tool run
